trial_court: Dist. Judge Family Court Gulbarga, O.S. No.30/2013
case_name: Saleha Julekha W/O. Mohammed Bismilla vs Mohammed Bismilla S/O Late Abdul Raheem
facts_of_case: Plaintiff and defendant got married in 2002, had two children, but defendant started quarreling without cause, neglected plaintiff and children, and went to her parents' house.

legal_principles.principle: The Hindu Marriage Act and its provisions are applicable only to Hindus and not to Muslims, Christians, Parsis, or Jews.
legal_principles.held: On going through the above provision of law it indicates that the Hindu Marriage Act and its provisions are applicable only to Hindus and it is not applicable to Muslim, Christian, Parsi or Jew's.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage celebrated under the personal law cannot be set right or restored by the law belonging to other religion.
legal_principles.held: The parties will be governed by their personal law.

outcome.final_order: The judgment and decree passed in O.S. No.30/2013 dated 30.04.2014 were set aside.

use_for_drafting: drafting divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
appealing against family court judgment in Karnataka
using Section 19 of Family Court Act for appeal
